fields.why: The Summary's headline claim is updated dose vs 'no receipt of an updated vaccine dose' (pair), which leads under the v5 rule; the interval strata (7-59, 60-119 days) are each contrasted with the same referent.
The article is silent on clustering in a multisite, multi-encounter EHR network, and it does not say the units are independent, so v: null applies (V11).
